title: View Kind nemar.histogram, Version 1
description: Generic histogram, applied on top of the envelope to a view declaration whose kind is nemar.histogram and kind_version 1. One stored JSON file is read as the role histogram, and its content meets content.nemar.histogram.v1. The content holds counts per bin, binned either by numeric edges or by named categories, and a renderer draws the stated counts without recomputing them. A renderer builds the model in docs/views/generic-kinds.md. This is a generic kind, so it has no base, no inputs, no transform, no parameters and no dimensions.

base.description: A generic kind has no base.

base_version.description: A generic kind has no base.

inputs.description: A histogram is stored data only.

transform.description: A histogram is stored data only.

data.description: Exactly one file, read as the role histogram.

items.description: The role histogram: one JSON file whose content meets content.nemar.histogram.v1. A preset drawn over this kind meets this subschema with its own histogram entry (docs/views.md, the role contract).

columns.description: A JSON role has no columns.

dims.description: The bins are in the content, not in dimensions.

content.description: The schema the role's file meets. It is not applied to the declaration; this reference names it, so a tool that bundles the schemas a declaration reaches also bundles the content schema.
